summary.text: Justin Slaughter, a Democrat, has represented Illinois's 27th House District since January 2017.

paragraphs.text: According to the General Assembly biography, he previously worked as a policy advisor to Governor Pat Quinn and as deputy director at the Illinois Department of Juvenile Justice, and as district director for Cook County Commissioner Stanley Moore and State Senator Kwame Raoul.
He holds a B.A. in political science from the University of Chicago and a master's degree in public policy and administration from Northwestern University.
The biography says he is a Chicago native who grew up in and still lives in the Washington Heights community.
